_comment: Project 10 - Cloudflare edge CONFIG backup (off-platform). The edge data-plane is stateless, so the asset we protect and recover is the CONFIGURATION. Restore a rule by recreating it in the dashboard: Security > WAF > Custom rules > Create rule, pasting the expression below.

custom_rules.name: Block-SQLi-Patterns
custom_rules.expression: lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.query)) contains "union select" or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.query)) contains "' or 1=1" or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.query)) contains "'--" or lower(url_decode(http.request.uri.query)) contains "sleep("
